Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files and requiring RSA decryption keys
Use of leaked RSA decryption keys in hex format for decryption
Mischa uses some source code from Chimera ransomware after gaining access to Chimera development system
Indicators of Compromise: Approximately 3500 leaked RSA decryption keys for Chimera ransomware in hex format
Attack Vector: Access to Chimera development system by Mischa devs to obtain code and decryption keys
